outcome: Composite maternal outcome (early postpartum hemorrhage, blood transfusion, operative complications, postpartum complications, and clinical chorioamnionitis)

Composite neonatal outcome (neonatal death, cardiopulmonary resuscitation in the delivery room, grade 3 or 4 intraventricular hemorrhage, necrotizing enterocolitis, culture-proven sepsis, birth trauma, arterial cord gas pH less than 7 or base excess less than -12, and 5-minute Apgar score 3 or less)
cohort: Singleton preterm births (23-34 weeks of gestation) in a tertiary center
finding: In indicated early preterm births, induction of labor was not associated with an increased risk of composite maternal or neonatal outcomes compared to planned cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Induction of labor in indicated early preterm births was not associated with an increased risk of adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes compared to planned cesarean delivery.
